app.title: Wanted
app.subtitle: Kenshi bounty checklist
app.description: Tick off the criminals you have already captured. Your progress is saved in this browser, so you can refresh the page without losing it.

tip.title: Tip
tip.text: Deliver the criminal alive to collect the full bounty. Handing in a corpse only pays half.

progress.title: Progress
progress.resetConfirm: Are you sure you want to erase all your progress? This cannot be undone.

notes.poster: Only the wanted-poster value is known; the in-game amount may differ.
notes.headSale: No body to deliver: loot the head and sell it to any vendor.
notes.sharedBounty: The United Cities and the Traders Guild share bounties, so the wiki lists this one as doubled (c.20,000).
notes.higherThanPoster: The in-game bounty is higher than the printed poster.
notes.noPoster: There is no wanted poster, but the game sets a bounty.

empty.title: No results
empty.text: No criminal matches the current filters.

errors.loadText: If you opened index.html straight from disk, the browser blocks loading JSON files. Serve the folder with a local server (for example: python -m http.server) or publish it on GitHub Pages.

footer.sources: Data from the Kenshi Wiki (CC BY-SA) and Kenshi game files.
footer.disclaimer: Fan project, not affiliated with Lo-Fi Games. Kenshi © Lo-Fi Games Ltd.

difficulty.label: Difficulty
difficulty.hint: * Estimated difficulty: our own rating based on guards, surroundings and combat level. It is not official game data.
